metadata.question: Did the water in Lake Bosumtwi appear more green in December 2024 than in December 2015?

data.raw_code: The question asks: "Did the water in Lake Bosumtwi appear more green in December 2024 than in December 2015?" Interpretation: 1. We need to compare water "greenness" between two time periods: December 2024 vs December 2015. 2. "More green" suggests we should use a vegetation index like NDVI or EVI, or perhaps the green band itself. 3. Since this is about water, we should be cautious - water typically has negative NDVI values, but "more green" might mean higher chlorophyll-a content (algae blooms). 4. Better to use a water quality index like the Normalized Difference Chlorophyll Index (NDCI) or Floating Algal Index (FAI) for inland waters. 5. Location: Lake Bosumtwi in Ghana (approximately 6.5°N, 1.4°W). 6. Time: December for both years (full month). 7. Data source: Sentinel-2 or Landsat for water quality monitoring. 8. Need to check for data availability and handle cloud masking. Plan: 1. Use Sentinel-2 MSI (COPERNICUS/S2_SR) for both periods if available (better for water quality). 2. If no data, fall back to Landsat 8/9. 3. Calculate NDCI: (B5 - B4) / (B5 + B4) for Sentinel-2 (705nm - 665nm) which detects chlorophyll. 4. Compare mean NDCI values over the lake area. 5. If 2024 NDCI > 2015 NDCI (by a meaningful threshold), answer A (Yes), otherwise B (No). 6. Handle all edge cases (no data, no valid pixels, calculation failures). Edge cases: - Lake Bosumtwi is a crater lake, relatively small (~8 km diameter). - December in Ghana is dry season, but may have some clouds. - Need robust cloud masking. - Check pixel counts after masking. Implementation steps: 1. Define geometry (polygon around Lake Bosumtwi). 2. Get Sentinel-2 collections for Dec 2015 and Dec 2024. 3. Apply cloud masking using QA60 band. 4. Calculate NDCI for each image. 5. Create median composites for each period. 6. Compute mean NDCI over lake area. 7. Validate results (check for NaN, check pixel counts). 8. Compare values with a threshold (e.g., difference > 0.01). ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const lakeBosutmwi = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[-1.48, 6.55], [-1.48, 6.45], [-1.32, 6.45], [-1.32, 6.55]] ]); const dec2015 = ee.DateRange('2015-12-01', '2015-12-31'); const dec2024 = ee.DateRange('2024-12-01', '2024-12-31'); // Function to get and mask Sentinel-2 data function getSentinel2Collection(dateRange, geometry) { return ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR') .filterBounds(geometry) .filterDate(dateRange.start(), dateRange.end()) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 80)) .map(function(image) { // Cloud masking using QA60 band const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask); }); } // Function to calculate NDCI for Sentinel-2 function addNDCI(image) { // NDCI = (B5 - B4) / (B5 + B4) return image.addBands( image.normalizedDifference(['B5', 'B4']).rename('NDCI') ); } // 2. Data Acquisition & Check let col2015 = getSentinel2Collection(dec2015, lakeBosutmwi).map(addNDCI); let col2024 = getSentinel2Collection(dec2024, lakeBosutmwi).map(addNDCI); // Check collection sizes const size2015 = col2015.size().getInfo(); const size2024 = col2024.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2015 Images: ${size2015}, 2024 Images: ${size2024}`); // Fallback to Landsat if Sentinel-2 has no images if (size2015 === 0 || size2024 === 0) { console.log("Trying Landsat 8/9 as fallback..."); // Function for Landsat collection function getLandsatCollection(dateRange, geometry) { const landsat8 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(geometry) .filterDate(dateRange.start(), dateRange.end()) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 80)); const landsat9 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(geometry) .filterDate(dateRange.start(), dateRange.end()) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 80)); return landsat8.merge(landsat9) .map(function(image) { // Apply scaling factors for Landsat const opticalBands = image.select('SR_B.').multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2); const thermalBands = image.select('ST_B.*').multiply(0.00341802).add(149.0); return ee.Image.cat([opticalBands, thermalBands]) .copyProperties(image, ['system:time_start']); }); } if (size2015 === 0) { col2015 = getLandsatCollection(dec2015, lakeBosutmwi); // Landsat NDCI approximation: (B5 - B4) / (B5 + B4) col2015 = col2015.map(function(img) { return img.addBands( img.normalizedDifference(['SR_B5', 'SR_B4']).rename('NDCI') ); }); } if (size2024 === 0) { col2024 = getLandsatCollection(dec2024, lakeBosutmwi); col2024 = col2024.map(function(img) { return img.addBands( img.normalizedDifference(['SR_B5', 'SR_B4']).rename('NDCI') ); }); } // Re-check sizes const newSize2015 = col2015.size().getInfo(); const newSize2024 = col2024.size().getInfo(); console.log(`After fallback - 2015: ${newSize2015}, 2024: ${newSize2024}`); if (newSize2015 === 0 || newSize2024 === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } } // 3. Processing - Create median composites const comp2015 = col2015.select('NDCI').median(); const comp2024 = col2024.select('NDCI').median(); // Check valid pixel counts const reducer = ee.Reducer.count(); const count2015 = comp2015.reduceRegion({ reducer: reducer, geometry: lakeBosutmwi, scale: 100, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDCI').getInfo(); const count2024 = comp2024.reduceRegion({ reducer: reducer, geometry: lakeBosutmwi, scale: 100, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDCI').getInfo(); console.log(`Valid pixels 2015: ${count2015}, 2024: ${count2024}`); if (count2015 === 0 || count2024 === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // 4. Calculation - Get mean NDCI values const meanReducer = ee.Reducer.mean(); const ndci2015 = comp2015.reduceRegion({ reducer: meanReducer, geometry: lakeBosutmwi, scale: 100, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDCI').getInfo(); const ndci2024 = comp2024.reduceRegion({ reducer: meanReducer, geometry: lakeBosutmwi, scale: 100, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDCI').getInfo(); console.log(`NDCI 2015: ${ndci2015?.toFixed(4)}, 2024: ${ndci2024?.toFixed(4)}`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (ndci2015 === null || ndci2024 === null || isNaN(ndci2015) || isNaN(ndci2024) || Math.abs(ndci2015) > 1 || Math.abs(ndci2024) > 1) { console.log("C3"); } else { // If 2024 NDCI is greater than 2015 by more than 0.01 (meaningful difference for NDCI) const threshold = 0.01; if (ndci2024 - ndci2015 > threshold) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
